12-7\n\nOh Wourha, how I long to room with you, my most beloved of Knowledge Keepers. I have searched the tower high and low for the right book to give you, one that would truly show the depth of my feelings!

17-7

Today I awoke to the horrid screaming of Yatiop, another of Siraatsu's servants. I ran straight away to her chambers and found that she had a large gash from chin to forehead. She explained to me that Siraatsu had not been at all pleased with the breakfast she was served. I must get out of this dreadful castle.

3-8

After a relatively calm few weeks, another fearful incident has occurred! My dear friend Naer told me a terrible rumor. The queen is apparently manufacturing mechanical servants and we will all be unemployed or worse within a month's time. I wanted to leave anyway, in fact I am quite unclear as to why I am still here now. I cannot remember?

6-8

Naer and Yatiop have flung themselves from the castle's windows directly into the sea below. I cannot bear to remain here and yet...

19-4

Head Sin Keeper Huokdo has recently taken an artifact from storage, it appears to be a large silver egg originated from the Dekanima. I feel a bit uneasy about this, artifacts from the Dekanima are quite dangerous and keeping them under lock and key is one of our primary duties here. Perhaps it was merely due for some sort of inspection.

3-5

Huokdo and a small group of other Keepers have been performing daily rituals around this egg for several weeks now. Signs of the Dekanima have begun to show around the tower, what in the world are they doing? I have begun preparations to abandon my post here, the oath I swore will be broken but I do not care. I will not lose my soul due to Huokdo's foolish ambitions. 

8-5

I have lingered too long, I underestimated how quickly things would become dire. I must make my escape NOW. The blood-curdling screams of the other Sin Keepers and the screeches of horrible beasts echo throughout the tower. A door to the Dekanima has opened, may Wodaso watch over me.

2-7

Today we begin our pilgrimage through the ancient Deimpo Mausoleum. Through these winding corridors and chambers are many graves of saints, legends, and even shrines to the great god Wodaso and goddess Puwema.

King Gius Abraon and a company of knights are here as well, venturing into the depths in some quest or another, though they do not speak of the details of their purpose here. The knights offered us escort down the main stairway, but from there it seems our paths diverge. No matter, the mausoleum is relatively safe and we should be fine on our own as generations of pilgrims were before us.

2-8

Yesterday was a disaster, a true nightmare. I brought the book I had carefully selected to Wourha's office and presented it to her. For a moment my heart fluttered as she handed me a book in return! This book though... is not what I had hoped for at all. It's a dark and grotesque book describing the most demented and horrifying things I've ever read of.

Why in the world did Wourha think a girl like me would want to read such a thing? She even urged me NOT to read the incantations from the back of the book aloud. If this is the kind of thing that interests her, perhaps I will do it anyway. Maybe whatever comes of these incantations will make me more appealing to her.

3-12

Okmaru and I have finally arrived at this most sacred shrine dedicated to lord Jigeki. We took the day to pray and make ritual in his name before this statue of his holy visage. There was a small metal piece on the altar here resembling part of Jigeki's symbol, Okmaru has insisted on taking it with us. 

Tomorrow we set out for the cavern beyond here, we'll have to pass by goddess Puwema's temple on the way. I wanted to pay homage to her as well, the great goddess is Jigeki's counterpart after all, but Okmaru insists we keep our distance. Her beliefs are not quite the same as mine, as I understand it she despises the goddess.

3-13

We'd made our way through the ruins past Puwema's temple and down into the caverns when suddenly the water became quite violent. I began to rush for this small outcropping of land but Okmaru seemed frozen in place, a look of terror on her face. I was screaming for her to follow when suddenly the silt beneath her feet began to shift and bubble and a tremendous fish erupted from the surface. 

I could hardly believe it, the fish had swallowed Okmaru whole and sunk back beneath the silt, I don't know what to do. I can't bring myself to go back into the water yet there is no other way out of here.

30-7\n\nI found it! A most perfect book that would truly show Wourha all that I cannot bring myself to speak to her aloud! I will bring her the book tomorrow and then surely she will come running into my arms.

4-26

Today a fortune teller told me I would encounter the wheel of fortune deep beneath the ground on a sacred isle. When I asked her for clarification she just... winked at me and made crude hand gestures. What an odd fortune, only a fool would get their hopes up from something so vague.

4-27

I encountered a ragged man in an alleyway who told me something quite strange. He recounted a tale of a beautiful woman who spins fine thread and greatly pleases any man who rings her bell and offers coin. He said this woman lives in a cavern deep below the Isle of Neasied. This can't be a coincidence, it lines up so exactly with yesterday's fortune. I set sail for Neasied tomorrow.

5-20

I've been wandering this wretched underworld for weeks and I think perhaps I have finally arrived in the cavern the ragged man described. Any day now I'll find that bell and finally alleviate my burdens.

5-22

I found the bell but it's up quite high on this crumbling structure. I must calm down and concentrate. I know I could hit that bell with a stone if I could just stop breathing so heavily.

4-7

Gods save us, the dead have come alive and all manner of horrors have appeared. We lost several today in the chaos, I pray Puwema protects us while we rest in her holy shrine.

The echoes of the knights' voices carry here from some chamber further inside, our only hope lies in rejoining them. Going back the way we came would be far too dangerous.

5-22

I've been down here for nearly a month and sure enough the waters in this cavern are slowly but surely becoming tainted by something most foul. Today I made my way into this sealed room which appears to be some sort of shrine dedicated to the god Jigeki, yet the figure depicted is an Orbewa woman. It seems to be quite new, much more recent than the statues depicting Yubior as the avatar of Jigeki. 

I'm not sure what exactly to make of this, it seems quite likely that the befouled waters and this shrine are connected somehow. I really should end this expedition soon and return to the surface to report my findings, I've caught notice of a few signs that I'm not alone down here.

A Blood Angel risen from the Dekanima ritual pit in the Verdant Hollow, nothing evades her watchful eye.\n\nThese Josami walk between two worlds, their bodies regenerate through blood magic and their souls able to return to the body after mortal wounds are suffered.

A Blood Angel risen from the Dekanima ritual pit in the Verdant Hollow, she fights like she's got nothing to lose.\n\nThe Josami Blood Angels were enhanced by Queen Siraatsu in a ritual involving blood sacrifice at a gateway to the Dekanima.

A Blood Angel risen from the Dekanima ritual pit in the Verdant Hollow, she is a crazed fighter who wields a shredding mechanical mace. \n\nThe powerful twin lords that once lead this Josami unit were so dangerous, the queen had them locked away in a long forgotten dungeon.

A Blood Angel risen from the Dekanima ritual pit in the Verdant Hollow, she is a tactical fighter who wields a spear and a large magical shield.\n\nUnfortunately for Siraatsu, the Blood Angels are too difficult to control to be tactically effective. After each temporary death, their souls return changed. Madness and rage overtaking their minds, just what do they experience on the other side?

A Rustic necklace crafted by the Orbewa people. The wood and beads have been soaked in a variety of oils extracted from folk remedies found deep in the ocean. Wearing it provides a small resistance to many common ailments.
A automaton performing drilling and repair work on Castle Siraatsu, it's been programmed to prioritize removal of unwanted visitors.
A beastly slithering insect, covered in hard shells and bearing fangs on both ends. \n\nRumor has it that a long-lost cult of warriors raised these creatures and lived symbiotically with them.
A beastly slithering insect, covered in hard shells and bearing fangs on both ends. \n\nThis variant species carries a weakening toxin and prefers a nice, damp environment.

A biography of Ikku, the current head sage of the Abraon royal family. It recounts his centuries-long life, in excruciating detail. Apparently the sage is quite fond of shrimp from the western continent, you never would have guessed.

A biography of Queen Siraatsu detailing the bizarre events of her life. According to the tales within, Sipeha came to Siraatsu and inhabited her while she lived on a vessel that journeyed through the void of space many millennia ago. 

It goes on to detail Siraatsu's rule over another world and her role in the construction and relocation of humanity to the world you now inhabit. 

You find this nearly impossible to believe and yet, could magic alone explain what you've seen in the ancient world found deep beneath the Isle of Neasied?
A black and white blade with a distinctive red streak. Attached to the pommel is a charm resembling the lovable mascot Pyp.\n\nWhen charged it can unleash a bright yellow wave of radioactive energy.
A black mechanical gargoyle bearing a pike tipped with the symbol of Wodaso. \n\nIt was instructed to guard this small temple of the god Wodaso by the Sin Keepers, for it holds forbidden secrets.
A blood red key forged in the style of Josami armor.

A body dumped unceremoniously underground, it awoke twisted and malformed with all manner of foliage springing from its back. \n\nIt crawls about in a haze of anger and confusion attacking anything in sight.
A book about preparing food and hosting leisurely activities for humans. Why is it written from this context?\n\nNo matter, the recipes sound extremely delicious and you would love to try them.

A book about the Kingdom of Ommu located on the southern continent. Ommu was allied with the Kingdom of Muojwi in the war many millennia ago. A few centuries ago they declared war on the Kingdom of Bamaen and lost that war as well. Despite relative peace, there is still tension between Ommu and Bamaen.
A book about the life of Yubior, avatar of the god Jigeki. \n\nThe last recorded tale takes place only ten years ago, with Yubior venturing into the caverns beneath the Obmuer Temple.
A book containing tales of dragons and their representations throughout history.\n\nAccording to this book these creatures do not exist, though you would swear you saw one once

A book detailing Goseus, avatar of Wodaso's exile from this world. It seems he travelled deep under the world and constructed something called the moon. Within this moon he built enormous structures which house the souls of the dead until they can be reborn. This was done out of necessity and as penance for continuing to engage in the use of forbidden technologies. \n\nThe events described are a bit over your head.

A book filled with hundreds of magical short stories to set the imagination alight. 

Each tale appears to contain a relatively timeless moral lesson of one kind or another. 

You fondly remember reading these stories in your youth, though it seems many did not have such an opportunity.

A book of strange tales describing impossible spaces and unimaginable beings from other dimensions.\n\nIt appears to include diagrams and spells for invoking such beings and travelling to such places, certainly no one would be foolish enough to actually try this though.

A book of tales from the eastern continent, home of the lost Kingdom of Epha. In modern times the continent is inhabited by loose knit communities known as the Idinti Wanderers. Resources on the eastern continent are scarce as the landscape is mostly desert. Littered with forests of bone trees and multiple species of gargantuan spiders, it seems extremely harsh. A few mentions of ancient Epha structures hidden among the sands set your imagination ablaze, you daydream for a moment of the wonders they might contain.

A book that documents the life and death of Queen Siraatsu, avatar of the goddess Sipeha.\n\nShe is reported to have extended her life with black magic and ruled over all the lands in the world for hundreds of years. Her attempt at eternal rule was ended with her defeat at the hands of an unnamed avatar of Puwema many thousands of years ago.

A book that purports to catalogue over one thousand species of ratty bugs from across the world.\n\nOne variant is described as bearing a large metallic structure on its back for the purpose of increased aerodynamics while racing. You very much doubt the existence of many of the species described within.

A book that records pivotal battles of a war between the Kingdom of Epha and the Kingdom of Muojwi.\n\nEpha which was allied with your homeland of Bamaen seems to have won the war at great cost. Both the Epha and Muojwi kingdoms fell many thousands of years ago as a result.

A bottle of holy water from a hidden spring in the Kingdom of Epha. The location of this spring is a well kept secret, even among the rare explorer who would venture to such a distant region.\n\nSipping this effervescent liquid is a rare treat, sending a powerful surge of energy through your body that restores your magical energies.

A bracelet from another reality, it was originally found in a tower of forgotten nightmares. \n\nIt protects its wearer from harm a single time and then shatters. It has been blessed with an enchantment that restores it after a short time passes.
A bright golden crab, very rare and could fetch quite a high price. \n\nYou wonder if it will be eaten or kept as a pet.
A bright red crystalline egg held in a black metal stand.\n\nUsed in Josami blood rituals, you can feel an evil power emanating from within.
A brilliant azure orb radiating an unusual energy. \n\nIt feels as if you catch a glimpse of another world within.
A brilliant green dragon who was raised by Usunha. She will burn any who dares threaten her master with blazing breath of azure flame.
A bubbling mass of flesh and sharp bones surrounding a gaping maw. It spews waves of foul slime that inflict nearly every known ailment.

A bubbling mass of metallic flesh and sharp bones surrounding a gaping maw. It spews waves of azure flame. \n\nForbidden rituals performed in the castle have weakened the barrier between this world and the Dekanima, allowing it to slip through.

A bubbling mass of sticky white flesh and sharp bones surrounding a gaping maw. It spews waves of putrid sticky slime.\n\nYou'll want to have a healthy supply of soap on hand if you're to handle such a creature.
A cannon that fires a long range continuous particle beam. It's equipped with blades at the front for close range thrusting attacks.\n\nIt requires energy to operate.
A catfish-like Orbewa citizen, it spews waves of deadly poison from its wide mouth. \n\nThese Orbewa were blessed by the priestess Muagyo with an incantation of Jigeki's toxic magic.

A ceremonial stone tiara decorated with flowers and a seashell. Traditionally when an Orbewa man wishes to propose, he must offer a tiara decorated with flowers and shells to the maiden he fancies.\n\nIf the selection and arrangement of flowers are not to the maiden's liking however, little will come of the offering.
A chalice made from a hollowed out skull, filled to the brim with bubbling rot.\n\nNo matter what, you must not spill it.
A chalice made from a hollowed out skull, filled to the brim with churning poisonous goop.\n\nWhile the color is quite alluring, you do not dare to take a sip.
A charm that can be attached to the Mask of Second Sight.\n\nIt will help you find Data Modules.
A charm that can be attached to the Mask of Second Sight.\n\nIt will help you find Meals left by Chef Gagi.
A charm that can be attached to the Mask of Second Sight.\n\nIt will help you find Orbewa Eggs.
A charm that can be attached to the Mask of Second Sight.\n\nIt will help you find Star Lizards.
A charm that can be attached to the Mask of Second Sight.\n\nIt will help you find Strange Silver Etched Skulls.
A charm that can be attached to the Mask of Second Sight.\n\nIt will help you find Treasure Chests.
A chicket species found deep underground, its rotten flesh oozes sickening disease. It smells quite foul, attracting swarms of flies.
A citrine statuette depicting Yubior, the avatar of the rotten god Jigeki.
A clay jar, crudely affixed to the end of a stick. \n\nA makeshift weapon at best. Swinging it produces a small rattling sound.
A close relative of the otherworldly plants of the Dekanima, its permanent gaze is always watching.\n\nFires a debilitating beam at any human that falls under its gaze.
A club formed by twisted branches of living wood holding an immense verdant orb.\n\nThe Goddess Puwema's magic emanates from the orb, bathing the wielder in a rejuvenating light.
A club hewn from a rare dark branch. \n\nIt may appear crude at a glance however it's finely crafted weaponry for those with specific tastes.
A club hewn from a thick tree branch, leather wrapped around the thinner end to form a grip of sorts. \n\nDifficult to wield but certainly capable of a solid blow.
A coating of acid has been added, allowing it to dissolve growths of soft tissue spawned by the Necronomicon.
A common hand axe meant for chopping wood, it can also make an effective weapon in the right hands.
A common lantern which provides little light. When exploring dark places it's better than nothing.
A common looking data module, you should bring to Ossi so he can analyze its contents.
A common soldier's armament kept in storage for many years. \n\nOffers a long reach and little else.
A common soldier's armament left to decay on the battlefield. \n\nOffers a long reach and little else.
A compact Energy Cell that holds half as much energy.\n\nIt's hard to fathom how much more advanced the civilizations of the past seem to have been. What could have driven them so deep underground?
A complex mechanical arm. It has the name "Peha" etched into it.
A complex mechanical hammer from an age lost to time. It can discharge a wave of energy along the ground.
A complicated looking data module, you should bring to Ossi so he can analyze its contents.
A copper pendant in the shape of the symbol of god Wodaso.  The holy magenta gems affixed emit magic that greatly speeds physical improvement.
A crown befitting an emperor yes. You will wear it well.
A crown worn by Dagoom the Sea King, gifted to you by Erma for helping her recover the lost Orbewa Eggs.\n\nEnchanted by royal Orbewa magic which increases the speed of holy magic accumulation.

A crumbling fragment of stone, carved in the shape of a wing.

Hold it high above your head and you'll find yourself whisked away to a Wing Altar.

Stone fragments will crumble when travelling and are quite uncommon, so make sure to use them wisely.
A crystalline skull with twisted horns and unusual gems embedded.

A cudgel shaped from the wood of a tree found only where the cold winds blow. A faint scent of pine smoke lingers in the air around it, reminding you that it's not quite from around here.\n\nWhen the magic held in the gleaming gem affixed above its handle is discharged, it produces a wave of noxious poison, dispelled from within the wielder's own mind, calming the soul.
A cure-all potion sold by traders from the western kingdom of Ritudeon. \n\nDistilled from highly potent plants that grow only in the dense jungle at the center of the continent.
A dark looking data module, you should bring to Ossi so he can analyze its contents.

A dark stained fragment of bone said to be from the skeletal remains of Ruunen, avatar of Puwema. \n\nIt was used in an unholy necromantic ritual, you pray it was not authentic or the ritual's power would likely be immeasurable.
A deer-like insectoid creature bearing majestic horns and a deadly stinger. \n\nThough it has wings, it's a bit too heavy for sustained flight.

A detailed account of the Dekanima lies within the worn pages of this book. It describes an entire dimension whose makeup and rules are unlike those of our own. It describes an infinite expanse of sentient shifting metallic landscapes inhabited by equally unfathomable flora and fauna. Within this dimension is a being known as Okbujo, who seems to be something akin to a god.\n\nThe second half of the book details rituals, spells, and incantations for working the magic of the Dekanima, you dare not read them.

A detailed account of the Orbewa people's history and practices. Apparently they emerged from the sea only a few centuries ago and immediately were at war with the Kingdom of Bamaen for engaging in several forbidden practices. The details of these practices are unclear, it seems they were quickly bested and signed a peace treaty with Bamaen after just 2 months of war.

A diamond shaped metal plate with a cobalt blue orb of glass embedded in its center. \n\nUnseals doors to the generator towers by emitting a short esoteric song and magical light when merely holding it before them.
A diamond shaped metal plate with a glass cup embedded in its center. \n\nUnseals cup doors in Siraatsu Castle.
A diamond shaped metal plate with a glass pentacle embedded in its center. \n\nUnseals pentacle doors in Siraatsu Castle.
A diamond shaped metal plate with a glass sword embedded in its center. \n\nUnseals sword doors in Siraatsu Castle.
A diamond shaped metal plate with a glass wand embedded in its center. \n\nUnseals wand doors in Siraatsu Castle.
A diamond shaped metal plate with a teal green orb of glass embedded in its center. \n\nUnseals certain doors by emitting a short esoteric song and magical light when merely holding it before them.
A diamond shaped metal plate with an orange ocre orb of glass embedded in its center. \n\nUnseals certain doors by emitting a short esoteric song and magical light when merely holding it before them.
A diamond shaped stone key plated with bronze and lined with blood red stone. \n\nUmbada purchased this from a traveller named Taebba and assures you it is quite valuable.
A diamond shaped stone key plated with gold and lined with bright green jade. \n\nFound in a treasure vault, it seems it may unlock a door to yet more treasure.
A diamond shaped stone key plated with silver and lined with blue velvet. \n\nFound in a treasure vault, it seems it may unlock a door to yet more treasure.

A dish served to only the most refined gourmets. 

Crisp thin crust topped with red sauce, mounds of fresh cheese, and fine western herbs, baked until bubbling and slightly browned. 

The unique combination of ingredients improves your ability to heal.

A distinguished looking brass monocle worn by a docile gargoyle in the Tower of Knowledge.\n\nWhile you might assume it wore this monocle to assist in reading books, the reality is the lens has fallen out and  it must simply be a fashion statement.
A dreadful beast with the body of a lion, a scorpion's tail, and the face of a man. \n\nIt was sent to the Tower of Knowledge by Queen Siraatsu to retrieve the Necronomicon.

A dreadful creature that stalked the Dekanima, cloaked in a light-bending coat of metallic skin.\n\nThe Sin Keepers experimented with forbidden knowledge they were sworn to conceal. They paid dearly for this and now the Dekanima spills through into the Record of Sin.
A duck carved from a strange ancient stone.\n\nCertainly Umbada would find this fascinating.
A duck figurine cast from fine silver.\n\nIt seems likely that Umbada will enjoy it.
A duck figurine constructed from fine metal work. It softly emits a metallic hum, how peculiar. \n\nUmbada simply must see this.
A dull brown crystalline egg held in a green metal stand.\n\nUsed in occult Josami rituals, you can feel an evil power emanating from within.
A fearful little lizard that clutches a bag of treasure in its tiny hands.\n\nA rare type that lives deep underground in places long forgotten by most. Oh the sights these lizards must have seen.
A fearful little lizard that clutches a bag of treasure in its tiny hands.\n\nIts unique star shaped tail and frill may be its namesake but you'll remember it for its dreadfully loud scream.

A fearful little lizard that clutches a bag of treasure in its tiny hands.\n\nQuite the macabre type, it spends its days hanging out near graves. Known for its distinctive pale face paint and refusal to conform with the broader Star Lizard society.

A fearful little lizard that clutches a bag of treasure in its tiny hands.\n\nThis subspecies has adapted itself for wetter environments and certainly enjoys a nice relaxing bath after a long day at the office.

A fearful little lizard that clutches a bag of treasure in its tiny hands.\n\nThis subspecies lives deep underground, in a world unlike most people have ever dreamed possible. It shows little appreciation for the wonders that surround it though, instead still clutching to a dirty little bag.

A fearful little lizard that clutches a bag of treasure in its tiny hands.\n\nThis variety is known to spend all day reading indoors. However, it seems to mostly enjoy picture books and it's unclear if it can actually read at all.

A fearful little lizard that clutches a bag of treasure in its tiny hands.\n\nThough it seems as fearful as any other variety of Star Lizard, it was somehow bold enough to secure a luxurious life living in a castle.
A fearful little lizard that clutches a bag of treasure in its...\n\nWait no, it has a bomb! By the gods, run!

A feather adorned blade forged for a gentleman of distinguished tastes. It's owner is known to be something of a bard and most certainly not a bunch of worms in a human skin, don't be ridiculous. \n\nThe mesmerizing gem mounted at it's guard can call forth majestic screaming birds, somehow this seems familiar.

A few weeks ago I exchanged books with my dearest friend Inha. I've left the book she lent me over there, its contents made my cheeks quite flushed to be honest. In comparison the book I lent her was quite grim, I hope she doesn't take it the wrong way. If you see her, please let her know I quite enjoyed the book and would love to room with her when this whole mess blows over.
A fine silvered duck, quite beautiful indeed. As thanks I'll make some new wares available to purchase.
A finely crafted bladed rapier used by royal soldiers of the Bamaen army in a war fought long ago. \n\nIt has been lightly enchanted and it can perform the legendary thousand strike sword technique

A finely crafted dagger belt bestowed upon Prince Beruim Abraon as a coming-of-age gift. 

A powerful enchantment causes the daggers carried by this belt to return to their sheaths when thrown.

The dagger sheaths are adjustable and could likely hold all manner of throwing weapons.
A finely marbled hunk of meat, seasoned and roasted to perfection. \n\nHigh in protein, this meal helps build strong muscles.

A fizzing bottle of bright red liquid extracted from brawler's berries. \n\nBrewed with additional ingredients which create a more potent boost to strength and a slightly improved flavor compared with simply eating the berries.
A flawlessly crafter golden duck, etched with ornate designs.\n\nYou have no doubt Umbada will find this enchanting.

A fleshy imp similar to the gargoyles excavated from beneath the Tower of Knowledge, however it's missing the regular coat of stone.\n\nIt seems to have hidden itself away in the cliffs above Obmuer Temple for quite some time.
A floating ball of agony, the gem protruding from its melting flesh emits waves of azure flame.
A floating ball of despair, the gem protruding from its putrefying flesh emits a powerful curse.

A flying creature from the Dekanima similar to a manta ray. It flows gracefully through the air and fires beams of powerful energy.\n\nThe Sin Keepers experimented with forbidden knowledge they were sworn to conceal. They paid dearly for this and now the Dekanima spills through into the Record of Sin.

A flying creature from the Dekanima similar to a manta ray. It flows gracefully through the air and fires beams of weakening energy.\n\nForbidden rituals performed in the castle have weakened the barrier between this world and the Dekanima, allowing it to slip through.
A flying insect that has grown to tremendous size. \n\nAt this size the usual prey will not suffice, awakening a hunger for human blood.
A forest-dwelling relative of the otherworldly plants of the Dekanima, its unblinking eye unleashes a torrent of azure flame.

A formidable mechanical knight plated in blackened copper armor and wielding two sharp hand axes.\n\nConstructed by the Kingdom of Muojwi to fight in a war that ended thousands of years ago. Now it roams the underworld beneath the Isle of Neasied, set to put an end to any trespassers it encounters.

A formidable mechanical knight plated in pristine steel armor and armed with a huge mechanical lance and spiked round shield.\n\nConstructed by the Kingdom of Muojwi to fight in a war that ended thousands of years ago. Someone has set it to watch over a forbidden key, hidden away atop the Deimpo Mausoleum.
A fragment of bone said to be from the skeletal remains of Ruunen, avatar of Puwema. \n\nWhile it's certainly quite old, verifying its authenticity is an impossible task.
A frail ancient short sword capable of a secret technique few know of.\n\nOnce Pandora's Box has been opened, only a fool would try to close it.

A friendly pebble from another reality, he once helped adventurers navigate the pale abyss. He's been mounted on a handle for use as a hammer, how cruel!\n\nYou can swing him around to crush your enemies. When his monocle shines, you can even fling him away as a high speed projectile. What ever did he do to deserve such treatment?
A funny little duck carved from stone. \n\nYou can sense a mercantile aura emanating from within.

A giant golden gavel forged for King Gius. The king often presided over the royal court, and he purportedly did use this gavel to proclaim his rulings.\n\nIt's socketed with 3 triangular magic gems, which once charged allow the wielder to release magical waves of judgement.
A gigantic rotting mass of flesh and sharp bones surrounding a gaping maw. It spews waves of disease-ridden bile.

A gilded snake twists around the striking end of this golden spear. \n\nBlessed by the God Jigeki, the snake lives in an eternal slumber, waking only to unleash a deadly venom when enthralled by combat.

A glaucusion that has grown to enormous size through experimentation by the Sin Keepers. It's flesh has become quite raw due to its rapid expansion.\n\nIts bite has become extremely deadly, shredding its prey's flesh as raw as its own.
A gold Orbewa crown. It was worn by Muagyo before she became the avatar of Jigeki.\n\nIt was found on what seems to be Yubior's grave, perhaps offered in mourning.
A gold figurine of a ratty bug, its surface etched with fine detail and inlaid with shining white gems.
A gold fish shaped treasure, its surface etched with fine detail and its eyes set with shining rubies.
A gold pendant of House of Abraon's crest. Held by members of the Abraon family to prove their identity when travelling abroad. \n\nIt has been enchanted with a blessing of defense and resistance.
A gold statuette depicting Queen Siraatsu, the last known avatar of the void goddess Sipeha.
A gold statuette depicting Ruunen, the avatar of the nature goddess Puwema in an ancient time.
A gold statuette depicting Yubior, the avatar of the rotten god Jigeki.
A gold statuette depicting an unknown avatar of the thunder god Wodaso.
A gold statuette of a star lizard, its surface etched with fine detail. It's been set with four gleaming rubies.

A gold trimmed black hammer fitted with a tremendous crimson orb. Able to cast a most foul spell which absorbs the life force from distant targets.\n\nIt was the favored weapon of Prince Emdaer from the Kingdom of Ommu who lead an army invading Bamaen centuries ago. According to legend, when the war was lost he set this hammer aside and cast himself into the sea.
A golden bell with a bright orange gem embedded. \n\nIt has an air of magic about it, its surface a bit warmer to the touch than the air surrounding it.
A golden ceremonial trident of the Orbewa people. \n\nIt can be used as a weapon, however the head seems to only be loosely affixed to the handle.
A golden duck shaped key that can unlock Umbada's signature bright yellow merchandise chests. \n\nHe wouldn't trust this to just anyone but where in the world could those chests be?
A golden fish, shining like the sun! You will treasure it always yes.
A golden lamp with a small window of green glass in its center. \n\nThe faint smell of something like dried herbs wafts from within.
A golden lamp with a small window of pink glass in its center. \n\nThe surface feels a bit electric to the touch and makes your hair stand on end, how strange.
A golden pendant in the shape of the symbol of goddess Puwema. The holy green gems affixed emit a gentle healing magic.
A golden stake forged in the shape of the symbol of the god Wodaso.\n\nCrafted for use in symbolic ceremony, it would not make a particularly effective weapon.

A golden torch blazing with otherworldly azure flames. It can be used to light ceremonial fires, set enemies ablaze, or simply as a light in the dark.  \n\nWhen magic accumulates in the affixed gems, it can hurl a blazing ball of azure fire.
A guide written by Jayphotic that explains just how he does it. \n\nFollowing the instructions within, things seem a bit tougher than usual. Perhaps this is some form of training.

A guitar-like sword forged for "the one of many names" and his band of warriors. What could go wrong with a blade like this in your hands? \n\nIts energy can realign to emit powerful sonic rings, this is not a reference to any type of hog.

A halberd forged of gold and scales from another reality where humanoid bugs inhabit the world, how unusual and charming!\n\nIt can be used to slash like an axe or thrust like a spear from quite a distance, proving to be a versatile weapon for many situations.
A hard clay jar, firmly affixed to the end of a stick. \n\nEccentric warriors may find this exactly to their tastes.

A hard, pungent-tasting fruit that can be found growing deep underground. 

Eating it raw improves your ability to see in the dark for a little while. 

While cooking it greatly improves the flavor and texture, the process unfortunately mitigates any useful effects.

A heavy  sword of polished stone crafted by Epha during the ancient war with the Kingdom of Muojwi.\n\nEach strike releases Epha stone magic and when the gem in its guard is fully charged it can unleash a devastating wide slash.
A hefty spiked club forged for a truly detestable pride demon. You can almost hear a voice whisper something foul on the wind as you hold it, who said that?\n\nSteals a bit of life with each strike.
A high-spec automaton drilling unit. It has multiple premium features not found on the standard models.
A high-spec automaton war machine. It has multiple premium features not found on the standard models.
A highly aerodynamic and extremely sharp mechanical throwing blade.

A historical record of the Isle of Neasied. It details the centuries-long construction and expansion of the Deimpo Mausoleum and the Tower of Knowledge. It also recounts the tale of the emergence of Obmuer temple from deep within the sea...\n\nIt's not of particular interest as you've heard these stories a thousand times in your youth.

A historical record of the Kingdom of Muojwi's uprising and battle against the Kingdom of Epha. A centuries-long war raged between all the kingdoms in the world, Epha allied with Bamaen and Muojwi allied with Ommu. \n\nWhile you've heard of this war many times, what catches your eye are details about the Muojwi arming themselves with technology from deep underground that had long ago been forbidden. These details are all but erased from records of the war found outside of the Record of Sin.

A historical record of the Royal Academy of Bamaen's founding several centuries ago. It contains painfully boring records of headmasters, teachers, fields of study, and ceremonial practices. \n\nHaving studied at the academy in your youth, this is the last thing you want to read about.
A holy amulet of the Orbewa yes. May it shine bright around your neck like the star.
A holy looking data module, you should bring to Ossi so he can analyze its contents.

A horrible mass of mutant flesh wielding scythe-like talons living inside of a treasure chest.\n\nPerhaps it's best to approach all such chests with caution as one can never be too sure what lies in wait inside.
A horrible mass of mutant flesh, wielding scythe-like talons living inside of an Epha stone chest.\n\nHow many ages has it awaited prey, locked away in such a forgotten place?

A horrible mass of scarlet-stained flesh wielding scythe like talons living inside of an extravagant treasure chest.\n\nYou've never seen a chest quite like this before and it seems unlikely you'll see one again. How frustrating.

A huge carafe of rejuvenating elixer, distilled from assorted herbs grown in the Kingdom of Bamaen. \n\nIn high demand for its longevity and consistent effectiveness, in such quantity it's sure to heal just about any wound..

A huge mangled corpse covered in bony protrusions from head to toe, the spike erupting from what was once a face so heavy that its neck has snapped and dangles limply.\n\nIt has been bound in decorative wrappings and cursed to watch over a hidden temple of Jigeki for hundreds of years.
A jade statuette depicting Ruunen, the avatar of the nature goddess Puwema in an ancient time.
A jar filled with fragrant dried spices from deep underground. As the scent flows through your nostrils a chill runs down your spine.
A jar filled with strange dried spices from an ancient land. The contents are of unknown origin and still carry an unfamiliar yet sweet and pungent smell.
A jet black longhammer decorated with the symbol of Sipeha and fitted with various rings, talons, and gems.\n\nIt can call orbs of living void that rip away all before them.
A katar "borrowed" from the Idinti warriors of the eastern continent by the Iryupe Raiders. \n\nIt can unleash a ghostly blade by harnessing the power of ancestral Idinti spirits.
A large automaton war machine that patrols Castle Siraatsu.\n\nSince Queen Siraatsu awakened, she's wasted no time restoring her mechanical army.
A large barnacle that stretches and exposes its neck to spit at passersby.\n\nPerhaps it does this to keep predators away, no matter the reason it's very rude.
A large black barnacle that stretches and exposes its neck to spit a noxious murky liquid at anyone entering its territory.

A large bottle of rejuvenating elixer, distilled from assorted herbs grown in the Kingdom of Bamaen. \n\nIn high demand for its longevity and consistent effectiveness, any serious adventurer should always have a few of these on hand.
A large bronze pendant, engraved with decorative patterns. The gleaming red gem affixed at its center emits powerful magic of strength.
A large hunk of steel, engraved with decorative patterns. The bright blue gem affixed at its center emits a strong protective magic.

A large insect that hatches into and then lives concealed inside of a book.\n\nBook Bugs are the progeny of a smaller ancient insect that made their way into the Tower of Knowledge from deep underground following the excavation beneath the tower.

A large metal skewer with plump ripe tomato and cob of corn affixed. The heavenly scent of the grilled vegetables is quite rejuvenating. \n\nWielding it requires immense willpower, one slip of the mind and you might lose control and devour the entire thing.

A large orda flower bud, picked just before it would've bloomed. \n\nThe gem-like pods on its petals contain a rare compound that prevents magical rot build up on the flower, allowing it to grow and thrive in unique environments.
A large, pale manticore that has been sent by Queen Siraatsu to keep watch over one of the sacred Wind Gems.
A larger than average Star Lizard coated with glittering metallic scales. \n\nIt always has a Steel Ale in hand, it's a bit of a problem really.
A larger than average Star Lizard with gleaming golden scales and a bright red frill. \n\nIt has quite a taste for Berserker's Brew.

A legendary blade of night covered in pitch black barbs, it is awarded to only the most dedicated adventurers.\n\nIts power is unmatched and it has been imbued with magic to protect its wielder from all danger.

A letter is attached to the small legally distinct mascot figurine, it reads:

"My Dearest Melpert,

I pray this weapon finds you well. I have crafted this stone weapon of vine and shroom for the express purpose of throwing at thine enemies. Regrettably, it does not spin when thrown. Nevertheless, it should serve you well as I am quite certain you are playing the game wrong and also this game sucks. 

Yours truly and forever,

Freshly Baked Games"
A living club found in the Dekanima, it's covered with sharp bone spikes.\n\nCapable of unleashing sharp pillars of giant bone from the ground when it becomes enraged.
A living firearm found in the Dekanima, it observes silently.\n\nIt spits forth vile plasma and exploding stone projectiles.

A living mushroom man from another reality. Once found growing in a massive spire of stone, now he's been thoroughly impaled on a sharp stick and seems to be quite dead, ready to be roasted to serve as survival food in worse times.\n\nWhen you swing this macabre weapon about, the manroom's corpse produces toxic spores.
A living spear found in the Dekanima, it steals the strength from those it pierces.\n\nIt can release a wave of strength stealing sludge.

A living white tree that was enshrined in a strange golden room, its cult of worshippers long passed away. \n\nIn its prime, this cult would consume ripe stone fruits that fell from the guardian's branches and keep the seeds as lucky charms.
A long range rifle that fires a jolt of electricity, it can be used to power certain machines. It can also unleash a paralyzing bolt that immobilizes foes. \n\nIt requires energy to operate.

A long wooden club affixed with the skulls of the original Knowledge Keepers. It can send forth ghostly chattering skulls to hunt its prey. \n\nThis macabre weapon is not befitting of the modern and professional standards of the Knowledge Keepers, so they have locked it away in the small cemetery atop the tower.

A lumpy little fish, saturated through and through with the Sea King's vile poison. \n\nIt's not clear how or why Dagoom stores these fish in his blowhole, thinking about it too much is a bit unnerving.
A magical looking data module, you should bring to Ossi so he can analyze its contents.
A magical pot given to you by Chef Gagi as thanks for returning many of his Meal Tickets. \n\nOn occasion, a delicious meal emerges from within, it's quite a mystery.
A magician such as yourself deserves a reward yes.
A majestic viridian ungulacrita that dwells in and is blessed by the magic of the Verdant Hollow. It casts deadly magic homing darts at its foes.

A mangled corpse covered in bony protrusions from head to toe, the spike erupting from what was once a face so heavy that its neck has snapped and dangles limply.\n\nIt shambles mindlessly through the mausoleum, seeking to impale anything in its path.
A manticore who dabbles in occult arts, he has been sent by Queen Siraatsu to keep anyone from venturing near goddess Puwema's temple in the Verdant Hollow.

A mask from another reality that protected its wearer from the curse of faces.\n\nWhile one need not wear such a mask here, it can impart thief like skills if you choose to put it on. Increases luck and improves your throwing weapon's return speed.
A massive hunk of ornately etched black steel attached to a sturdy rod. Quite difficult to wield but able to deal devastating blows.
A massive hunk of rusted iron attached to a sturdy rod. Quite difficult to wield but able to deal devastating blows.
A massive silver axe embellished with branches bearing azure buds. It can call forth a wave of azure flame.
A massive slab of iron with a scaled pattern up its fuller, wielding such a weapon requires great strength.
A massive slab of rusted iron, wielding such a weapon requires great strength.
A mechanical device that explodes on impact. Simply press the button on top and toss it.\n\nIt seems to be extremely ancient, luckily it seems well made enough to keep its volatile contents stable.

A mechanical gargoyle that is sworn to watch over the Record of Sin and neutralize anyone found lacking authorization.\n\nIt's armed with a gun that fires waves of binding magic to subdue trespassers.
A mechanical gargoyle that is sworn to watch over the Record of Sin and neutralize anyone found lacking authorization.\n\nIt's armed with a long warhammer to bludgeon any who set foot inside.
A mechanical spider dumped in the underworld beneath the Isle of Neasied after the ancient war with the Muojwi.\n\nCapable of delivering a shocking blast from its spinneret.

A member of Muagyo's congregation, led by the priestess of Jigeki Irdunuub.\n\nThey keep a watch over the sacred grounds above and within Muagyo's temple and perform rituals of the god Jigeki in her name. These rituals have corrupted the area around the temple with powerful magic and rotten waters.

A metal plated pyramid adorned with 2 solid wings carved from stone.

Hold it high above your head and you'll find yourself whisked away to a Wing Altar.

Carefully constructed ages ago using long forgotten techniques, it can withstand frequent travel.
A metal plated skull with twisted horns and unusual gems embedded.\n\nIn an age long past it was used in occult rituals, however any power within it seems to have long ago faded.
A mindless homopiscium that wanders the Rotting Cavern spewing waves of noxious swamp gas.
A miniature replica of Mr Quackers, mascot of Umbada's Trading Post. \n\nIt has some heft to it and could be used as a moderately effective throwing weapon.
A mirror with a surface so pitch black, nothing but the vaguest hints of reflection appear.
A mundane looking data module, you should bring to Ossi so he can analyze its contents.
A mysterious garden of stone, built long ago by visitors from the ancient Kingdom of Epha.
A mysterious statue of a giant bat, wings held up like it's draping a cape. It has a large sphere of green emerald inlaid in its base.
A mysterious statue of a homopiscium, it's taken a knee and looks quite serious indeed. It has a large sphere of red ruby inlaid in its base.
A mysterious statue of a pus bag, mouth agape and quite disgusting. It has a large sphere of blue sapphire inlaid in its base.
A mysterious statue of a ratty bug, its wings raised in a panic, it almost looks fearsome. It has a large sphere of purple amethyst inlaid in its base.
A mysterious statue of an ungulacrita, standing quite tall and majestic. It has a large sphere of black onyx inlaid in its base.
A nautigallus that was imbued with occult magic by Queen Siraatsu. It escaped the castle and made a nest in a pile of ancient scrap.
A nearly impossible to wield weapon forged from the arm of an ancient golem.\n\nEngraved in the handle is the name "Undercutz" whatever could it mean?

A necklace worn by Captain Aganmi of the Iryupe Raiders. He gave this to you as thanks for helping him learn the fate of his crew. \n\nThe magic gem affixed provides a small resistance to poison and produces a mild healing aura. Surely a boon during long voyages across the seas.
A necklace, I take that to mean the worst... well I suppose it's better than not knowing what happened at all.
A needle like silver rapier, usually carried by elite soldiers.
A numbered paper ticket that has "Chef Gagi and En's food services" written on it.\n\nIt has pictures of all kinds of food drawn on the front and what appears to be a gigantic crow drawn on the back.

A once in a lifetime find, this decorative metal trinket houses a finely polished azure crystal.

Squeeze it tightly in your palm and say a small prayer and you will be whisked away to a Crystal Monument. Unlike the more common brittle fragments, this well crafted piece will not break no matter how tightly it is held.

A priceless gift from the Epha, only the highest ranking knights of Bamaen would have been given to such an item.
A paralyzing needle used by the Idinti Wanderers to subdue tremendous arachnids that inhabit the eastern continents deserts.
A pearlescent-shelled ratty bug with a glittering shine. When threatened, it explodes in a blaze of shining glory, decimating all before it.
A peculiar ancient cutting tool that fires compressed waves of air.\n\nIt requires energy to operate.
A pile of hard black stones animated to keep trespassers out of the underworld beneath the Isle of Neasied.

A polearm that features a powerful sigil at its head combining a needle like tip and crescent blade allowing for versatile attacks. \n\nWhen its gaping red gem is alight with magic, it steals a bit of life essence from foes struck with it.
A polished stone throwing dagger forged by the ancient Epha. It slows foes to a crawl with Epha stone magic.
A prince? What are the odds of that, eh? Well you're welcome here all the same, as long as you have coin.
A putrid glaucusion that dwells in the fetid waters of the Rotting Cavern. The corrupting magic of Jigeki seeps from its pores.
A quartz statuette depicting an unknown avatar of the thunder god Wodaso.
A quick charging device for portable electronics. It seems to be compatible with Energy Cells, recharging them slightly faster than usual.

A rare mineral oil used to protect the surface of weapons from rust and decay.

The specific ingredients of this highly sought after concoction are a mystery, making it quite difficult to come by.

Applying this oil is a good way to let your weapon know you care about it, increasing the bond you share.

A rare purple root harvested in autumn. 

Traditionally prepared in stews and soups which warm the body and fend off disease. 

Less palatable in its raw form but more effective as a medicine.
A rare ratty bug with gleaming golden scales. \n\nIt's hidden itself away after years of pursuit by treasure hunters.

A rare relic from the war between Ommu and Bamaen, this strange blade absorbs the life force from foes it strikes. Press your hand firmly against the spikes on its handle to channel your own blood into the blade, fueling an extremely powerful magical slash.
A rare species of large ungulacrita, it has a unique bright coloration and stings with a highly toxic poison that weakens its prey.
A rather large crow named En. She's been fitted with a saddle so that Gagi can fly about on her back and deliver his mysterious meals all around the isle.
A rather large rat-like creature adorned with gleaming red shell and wings.\n\nUsually quite fearful of humans. Something on this isle has driven these creatures mad with rage.
A rather large sea-slug that defends itself from predators by slamming into them and excreting a shocking disease-ridden slime. \n\nThe bright color may be attractive but it's best not to touch it.

A ratty bug species thought to have been hunted to extinction for its rare blue shell decades ago.\n\nIt sports a large distinctive horn making it substantially more dangerous than its common red counterpart.

A record of the life of Peha, avatar of Puwema many thousands of years ago. It describes her life on another world that humanity once called home. She awoke from some kind of long sleep to find its inhabitants gone to the world we live in now.  She faced many automatons covered in human bones, and eventually escaped on some kind of vessel. She arrived on this world and defeated Queen Siraatsu using Puwema's magic and guided humanity in the establishment of its divided kingdoms. \n\nYou find this to be a somewhat dry historical account of entirely fantastical events that seem quite unlikely to be true.
A refined powdered tree bark imported from the southern kingdom of Ommu. \n\nThis renowned medicine near instantly relieves stiff joints and loosens tight and cramped muscles.
A relic from a war fought long ago, thoroughly rusted yet retains a sharp edge. \n\nIt still feels quite solid despite its apparent age.

A relic from an ancient war, this mechanical knight still functions despite a thick layer of flora growing from its every crack and crevice.\n\nUmbada must have repaired it to stand guard over his shop.
A repeating crossbow that carries the faint scent of hot dogs and ramen, how odd.

A replica of the Holy Sword Unok, sister of Holy Sword Endu. Though wielding it is similar in feel, it isn't capable of quite the same magical attacks as the real thing.\n\nThe original was destroyed when King Gius struck it against Queen Siraatsu's inhuman breast.
A rotten fish that swims in the fetid waters of the Rotting Cavern.
A royal looking data module, you should bring to Ossi so he can analyze its contents.
A rusted automaton knight from an ancient army. Though it hasn't seen combat for ages, its combat routines are still intact.
A rusted automaton soldier from a long-forgotten regime. It still contains the order: kill on sight.
A rusted automaton used for drilling and repair work in the ancient world. It has been reprogrammed to kill all intruders.
A rusted security drone that patrols in a never-ending search for trespassers. It's been programmed to fire on sight.
A rusted war machine that was decommissioned millennia ago. It has been reactivated with a single order: keep intruders out of the generator tower.
A scorched black skull, ablaze with magic flame. Summoned by Husipo to bind her enemies.
A scythe used in ancient death reaping rituals. Capable of hurling disease-ridden spinning shadow clone blades.
A security drone that patrols Castle Siraatsu. It will fire on intruders without hesitation.\n\nSince Queen Siraatsu awakened, she's wasted no time restoring her mechanical army.
A semi-transparent fish surging with otherworldly azure flame. Long ago it swam deep below the lake it resides in and encountered something most people, let alone fish, ever witness.
A sepiicanis that was imbued with occult magic by Queen Siraatsu. It escaped the castle and hid itself away in an abandoned lab.

A serf that has grown to near immeasurable size. It devours anything that sets foot in the befouled waters of the Rotting Cavern.\n\nWhen Okmaru ventured into the water the gigantic serf devoured her whole, it's a good thing the key wasn't dissolved by its stomach acid.

A series of first-hand accounts about the isolated Kingdom of Ritudeon who dominate the western continent. They are a relatively small and tribal kingdom, known to have very different practices and traditions compared to most of the world. The western continent is widely covered in dense jungles, within which many unique plants and animals can be found. \n\nOf particular note are a multitude of plants that have curative properties and a rare species of tree which produces an extremely hard and uniquely blue tinted wood, all commodities which are prized the world over.
A shambling mass of decaying flesh that wanders aimlessly through the waters of the Rotting Cavern.
A shambling mass of flesh summoned by the Necronomicon's Necrotic Bael flesh form.\n\nIt knows only pain and hunger.
A shattered zweihander that was repaired by filling the cracks with enchanted gold.\n\nWhen enough magic accumulates in the cracks it can unleash a paralyzing magic slash.
A siege weapon from a war fought long ago, the rusted metal head of the hammer is affixed to a creaky wooden pole. Slow to wield but has good reach.
A siege weapon from a war fought long ago, the silver plated head of the hammer is affixed to a solid wooden pole. Slow to wield but has good reach.
A silver bell with a bright blue gem embedded. \n\nIt has an air of magic about it, its surface a bit cooler to the touch than the air surrounding it.
A silver duck shaped key that unlocks the door to Umbada's Trading Outpost.
A silver figurine of a ratty bug, its surface etched with fine detail and inlaid with bright colorful gems.
A silver fish shaped treasure, its surface etched with fine detail and its eyes set with bright cerulean gems.
A silver pendant of House of Abraon's crest. Imparted to knights who perform exceptional deeds in service to the kingdom. \n\nIt has been enchanted with a blessing for strength and vitality.
A silver statuette depicting Queen Siraatsu, the last known avatar of the void goddess Sipeha.
A silver statuette depicting Ruunen, the avatar of the nature goddess Puwema in an ancient time.
A silver statuette depicting Yubior, the avatar of the rotten god Jigeki.
A silver statuette depicting an unknown avatar of the thunder god Wodaso.
A silver statuette of a star lizard, its surface etched with fine detail. It's been set with four cerulean gems.
A silver wreathed eye found growing in the Dekanima.\n\nFires a shredding beam of otherworldly energy.
A simple brass key dropped by the drilling unit found on The Tower of Knowledge rooftop. \n\nIt must fit the lock of the nearby chest which doubtless contains an extravagant treasure of some kind.
A simple silver bangle that has been enchanted with a spell of quick return. It's able to enhance the enchantment on your dagger belt, hastening the return of weapons thrown from its sheaths.
A sizable bird, defeathered and roasted to perfection. \n\nThe crisp golden skin and moist succulent meat nourish the body.
A skull plated in silver and etched with elaborate designs.\n\nYou can hear faint voices echo from somewhere inside.

A slick black spear wrapped in stained and shameful rags.\n\nAble to produce powerful magical waves of a mysterious liquid, though it will leave it's wielder quite sticky. Perhaps this is what the rags are for.
A small bottle of liquid that enhances ink generation of your grimoire's writing quill, allowing for more frequent inscriptions. \n\nJust think of all the strange things you'll be able to write now!

A small brittle fragment of gleaming azure crystal. 

Crush it in your palm while uttering a small prayer and you may find yourself at a Crystal Monument.

Crystal Monuments were constructed all across Bamaen by the Epha during the ancient war with the Kingdom of Muojwi. The crystals emit a healing aura as well as ward off evil, making them the ideal spot for weary warriors to rest after battle.
A small communication device that flashes the words "service unavailable" on its screen.
A small fragment of stone, carved with a blessing of protection. Often worn by those on pilgrimage to help bear the hardships.
A small golden pendant featuring the image of a cat.
A small metal charm affixed with a black tourmaline gemstone. Its aura speeds the expulsion of disease from the body.
A small metal charm affixed with a green agate gemstone. Its aura cleanses binding magic from the body.
A small metal charm affixed with a large block of white quartz. Its aura cleanses heaviness from the body.
A small metal charm affixed with a purple amethyst gemstone. Its aura speeds the expulsion of poisons from the body.
A small metal charm affixed with a red garnet gemstone. Its aura speeds the expulsion of weakening toxins from the body.
A small metal charm affixed with a white opal gemstone. Its aura helps cleanse sticky substances from the body.

A small sack sewn from rough spun fabric carried by Aquatic Star Lizards. \n\nBy its weight you judge it to contain a small metal bauble of some kind. It smells terribly rancid, you don't have the stomach to open it yourself.

A small sack sewn from rough spun fabric carried by Deep Star Lizards. \n\nBy its weight you judge it to contain a small metal bauble of some kind. There's a thick coat of slime covering it, you don't have the stomach to open it yourself.

A small sack sewn from rough spun fabric carried by Gleaming Star Lizards. \n\nBy its weight you judge it to contain a small metal bauble of some kind. A dark magical energy emanates from within, it would be foolish to open it yourself.

A small sack sewn from rough spun fabric carried by Grave Star Lizards. \n\nBy its weight you judge it to contain a small metal bauble of some kind. It's dripping with grave wax, you don't have the stomach to open it yourself.

A small sack sewn from rough spun fabric carried by Learned Star Lizards. \n\nBy its weight you judge it to contain a small metal bauble of some kind. A thick coat of mold covers it, you don't have the stomach to open it yourself.

A small sack sewn from rough spun fabric carried by Regal Star Lizards. \n\nBy its weight you judge it to contain a small metal bauble of some kind. It seems to be quite clean compared to similar loot sacks and yet, you don't feel like opening it yourself as it's tied quite tightly.

A small sack sewn from rough spun fabric carried by Star Lizards. \n\nBy its weight you judge it to contain a small metal bauble of some kind. It's absolutely filthy, you don't have the stomach to open it yourself.

A small scale stone model of an ancient city, excavated from beneath The Tower of Knowledge.

Such a strange and marvelous sight, no city with such grand walls as the model implies is ever known to have existed. 

Further research is being undertaken by the Royal Academy of Bamaen to determine if such a city truly existed at one point in history.
A small silver pendant featuring the image of a cat.
A small stuffed toy made in the image of a ratty bug. \n\nApparently everybody wants one of these but you aren't entirely sure why.

A small vial of rejuvenating elixer, distilled from assorted herbs grown in the Kingdom of Bamaen. \n\nIn high demand for its longevity and consistent effectiveness, this small vial contains just enough for basic treatment.
A small wooden charm, carved with a blessing of vitality. Its effect is minimal, however it carries a faint sweet smell which is quite pleasing.
A spear forged long ago in the Kingdom of Ommu. It has been imbued with an occult enchantment allowing it to produce a magical copy of itself when thrown.
A species of Meganeura that lives in the Rotting Cavern.\n\nThese foul creatures spew a weakening toxin from their behinds. How disgusting!
A species of Meganeura that lives in tropical climates. \n\nUnlike the more common type, it has a much harder, gleaming emerald shell and carries a slowing toxin in its stinger.
A stalker summoned from the Dekanima through the Josami Blood Angel ritual pool.\n\nThis creature's presence seems to be a side effect of the unholy ceremonies held within the chamber.
A standard issue blade for soldiers from the long forgotten ancient past. Energy can be run through its blade to deliver a paralyzing slash.
A standard morning star, used to bash and pierce armored opponents in battle.

A stone hammer, the head of which is shaped like the mascot of Umbada's Trading outpost. It seems to be extremely old.\n\nIt emits a magical aura of purity, once charged it can heal nearly any ailment.

A stone imp excavated from the caverns beneath the Tower of Knowledge. It wears a monocle and seems not to share the violent inclinations of its brethren.\n\nWourha believed she caught a glimpse of a gargoyle reading a book once. However, when she glanced away and back, it was as still as solid stone and she assumed she must have imagined it.

A stone imp excavated from the caverns beneath the Tower of Knowledge. While many lay dormant, this one has come to life and armed itself with a golden crossbow.\n\nWhat causes one to come alive and another to remain dormant remains a mystery. Perhaps it's just a matter of time.

A stone imp excavated from the caverns beneath the Tower of Knowledge. While many lay dormant, this one has come to life and armed itself with a golden halberd.\n\nThese creatures showed no signs of life when originally dug up, leading to their distribution across the Tower of Knowledge as decoration.
A strange cybernetically enhanced servant of Queen Siraatsu. It impales any who oppose the queen with its filthy metallic beak.
A strange cybernetically enhanced servant of Queen Siraatsu. She fires beams of binding magic from the massive wheel embedded in her torso.
A strange device that aids in physical training when affixed to the body.

A strange fruit which grows in coastal regions during the winter.

Its shell is quite difficult to crack open but well worth the effort. 

The sweet flesh releases an acidic compound that temporarily hardens the skin when consumed.
A strange looking data module, you should bring to Ossi so he can analyze its contents.
A strange mechanical man covered with bones.\n\nUnder its artificial breath it mutters "Peha..."

Melee weapons use the power meter - the yellow meter near the top of the screen - to determine their damage. The damage of an attack is higher the more full the meter is when attacking.

To attack with a melee weapon press {primaryattack_binding}.

All melee weapons have a secondary attack which can perform a variety of functions, so give them a try by pressing {secondaryattack_binding}!

Regarding the maintenance of the power station electric networks.

The power stations around this sector have all been routed to sealing off the castle bridge. In the event that power should fail at one station, the other two should maintain sufficient power to keep it sealed for at least a few years. Even so, it would be safest to keep them all running.
